title: Retired return policy
text: Unopened items have a 14 day refund window.

title: Current return policy
text: Unopened items have a 30 day refund window. Opened electronics have a 14 day return window.

title: Shipping policy
text: Standard shipping takes 5 business days. Express shipping takes 2 business days.

title: Internal payroll schedule
text: Staff payroll is processed on the 25th day of each month.

title: Other company returns
text: Unopened items have a 90 day refund window.

title: Support hours
text: Telephone support opens at 09:00 UTC and closes at 17:00 UTC on weekdays.
